issues.description: The problem statement requires the Farm to store animals in a List and explicitly instructs to use an ArrayList initialized in the no-argument constructor, but the provided solution uses a Queue<Animal> backed by a LinkedList. This mismatch between the specified collection type (List/ArrayList) and the implementation (Queue/LinkedList) can confuse students about the expected data structure and the return type of the getter/setter for animals.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem statement by changing the Farm implementation to use List<Animal> and initialize it with new ArrayList<>() in the no-argument constructor (and adjust getter/setter types accordingly), or alternatively update the problem statement to accept a Queue/LinkedList if that design was intended.
